modeDescription_general: Any photo of a person, with every everyday option.
modeDescription_portrait: A close portrait: the face, hair and light come first.

reasonMinor: Prompts with explicit content or lingerie must describe adults. Remove “{term}” (for example, write “adult woman” or “adult man”).
reasonNeedsAdult: Explicit and lingerie prompts need “Who” and an adult age range, in the Subject step.
reasonNeedsScene: Choose a scene or describe the place, to start.
reasonNeedsSubject: Choose who the photo is of, or describe the subject, to start.
clashHeading: These choices contradict each other, so the image may come out wrong:
clashHands: {items} need more than two hands, so the model may draw extra hands or arms.
clashPosition: {a} and {b} need different body positions, so the body may come out twisted.
clashMouth: {items} all use the mouth, so the face may come out distorted.
clashFacing: {a} turns the face away from the camera, but {b} needs it.
clashWeather: {a} can't be seen in a {b} scene.
clashAccessories: {items} are worn in the same place, so the model may draw both.
anatomyNote: These are written into the prompt only when they would be seen: the chest when topless, nude or in an open top, a bulge when clothed below, penis and pubic hair when fully nude, nipples when topless or nude (Intimacy step).
clashBuild: {a} doesn’t go with {b}, so the body may come out wrong.
